Menu.Name: Token HUD Folders
Menu.Label: Set up folders
Menu.Hint: Create folders with their own icon and drag the Token HUD buttons (including those from other modules) into them.

Players.Name: Folders for players too
Players.Hint: If enabled, players also see the folders in the Token HUD of their own tokens. Otherwise folders only apply to the GM.

Columns.Name: Buttons per row in a folder
Columns.Hint: How many buttons an opened folder shows side by side before wrapping to the next row.

Config.Title: Token HUD Folders
Config.PoolHint: Drag buttons into a folder. Double-click a button inside a folder to put it back. New buttons appear here once you have opened the Token HUD on a token.
Config.PoolNoneSeen: No buttons recorded yet. Right-click a token once to open its HUD (ideally a player character and an NPC), then reopen this window.
Config.DeleteConfirm: Delete folder "{name}"? Its buttons will appear normally in the HUD again.
Config.ForgetHint: Clears the list of available buttons, e.g. after disabling a module. They are recorded again the next time the HUD opens.
